videos.name: plazos
videos.prompt: Animate this exact engraved pocket watch as a restrained eight-second editorial still life. LOCKED camera. Preserve the exact original shape, perspective, silver steel-engraved crosshatching, dial, twelve hour marks, winding crown, chain and uniform deep indigo background throughout. The watch case and entire chain remain absolutely stationary. ONLY the existing LONG minute hand advances smoothly CLOCKWISE by a small restrained angle, about twelve degrees over the whole eight seconds. Its pivot remains fixed at the center. The short hour hand remains still. Do not add a second hand. No spinning or full revolutions, no wobbling, no stretching, no melting metal, no deformation of the dial or rim. Preserve all original safe margins, keep the whole watch and chain inside frame. No zoom, orbit, pan, camera shake, new props, letters, numerals, logos, characters, light flares, smoke or sparkles. Elegant subtly accelerated passage of time, professional scholarly engraving, not a realistic photograph. Silent video, no music, voices or sound effects.
videos.review: The complete source was inspected in a 16-frame contact sheet. Flow adds a thin second hand during the opening seconds. The UI uses only the stable segment from 3 seconds onward, with its matching first-frame poster. Watch case, chain and framing stay stable; the hands advance visibly. No locally generated motion.
videos.processing: Trim first 3 seconds; resize to 640x360; H.264 CRF25; audio removed. Poster extracted from the same Flow frame at 3 seconds.
